critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/promo-codes/email-history returns properly structured email logs
Each log includes: log_id, sent_by, sender_name, sender_email, total_emails, sent, failed, subject, personal_message, code_names, results array, created_at
Sender info is dynamically populated from user lookup (displays 'Ukjent' if user not found)
Code names array is populated by looking up actual code strings from code_ids
Results sorted by created_at descending (newest first)
Admin authentication required (401 for unauthorized requests)
Frontend tab bar renders correctly with 'Koder' (default) and 'Utsendelseshistorikk' tabs
History cards show: date/time, subject, status dots (green=success, amber=mixed), sent/failed counts, code names
Expandable details show: sender name, personal message (if any), recipient list with status and codes
Send e-post button visible on active code cards in Koder tab
